synthesis:draft.headline: Operational demand excludes small non-scheduled wind/solar, non-scheduled non-wind/non-solar and exempt generation (relative to native demand).

document_statements.quote: Operational demand differs from native demand in that it generally excludes demand met by non‑scheduled wind/solar generation of aggregate capacity < 30 MW, non‑scheduled non‑wind/non‑solar generation and exempt generation.
Non-scheduled (non-wind/non-solar or wind/solar <30 MW) generation is not forecasted, and therefore not generally included.
Measured operational demand is field “OPERATIONAL_DEMAND” in EMMS Data Model, as described in Appendix A2.
Native demand in a region is demand that is met by local scheduled 6, semi-scheduled7, non-scheduled8 and exempt generation9,
